## Astronomical 0.2.132
### Maximum model RAM
- A queued change now names the limit the engine will really install, never a figure larger than this Mac can reach. - While a change waits for the current reply to finish, the slider rests and Apply is not offered. - Normal states use the quiet text colour: reading part of a model from the SSD, a queued change and a successful update are not warnings. - Feedback uses plain words, such as "Maximum model RAM updated."
### Observatory
- On this Mac lists every model the engine serves, including copies in a configured model folder that match a catalog entry.
### Reliability
- When the inference worker stops before the engine's next message reaches it, the engine log now keeps the worker's exit status and the end of its error output. A worker that fails to start is also written to the engine log.
### Compatibility
- macOS 14.0 and later on Apple silicon. - Existing settings, conversations and downloaded models are preserved; no configuration fields were removed.
Signed with Developer ID, notarized by Apple and delivered through the signed Sparkle update feed.
